create_parakeet_feature_extractor: create a ParakeetFeatureExtractor instance with custom mel filter bank parameters for speech feature extraction
extract_fbank_features: extract log-mel spectrogram features from raw audio waveform using torch-based STFT computation
featurize_raw_speech: featurize raw speech numpy array or list of audio sequences into padded mel-filter bank input features
normalize_mel_features: normalize mel spectrogram features by computing per-sequence mean and variance ignoring padding
generate_attention_mask: generate attention mask tensor indicating valid frame positions after STFT and feature extraction
